$comment: Declarative conformance registry, mirroring germinate/conformance/cases.json. Each fixture's stdout MUST be byte-identical across every shell present. That identity is the losslessness proof.

shells.$comment: Candidate locales. The runner uses whichever are installed; bash-3.2 and posix(dash) are the load-bearing ones.

fixtures.asserts: lossless assoc-array over keys/values containing spaces, tabs, quotes, and shell metacharacters; insertion-order keys; delete; case shims; split
empty values, values with newlines, unicode, leading/trailing whitespace survive round-trip
